WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
), average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.payment_total) AS combined_payment_total,
       AVG(rt.payment_total - at.avg_payment_total) AS avg_amount_above_average
FROM rental_totals rt
CROSS JOIN average_total at
WHERE rt.payment_total > at.avg_payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;
